title: Claim
description: Factual statement extracted from the uploaded academic paper with attached citations, evidence, and verification.

document_id.description: UUID of the document from which claim was extracted

claim_text.description: Exact text of the factual claim

page_number.description: Page number where the claim appears

char_span.description: [start, end] character offsets in the page text

citations.description: Citations directly attached to or asserting this claim

verdict.description: Final verification verdict (null if insufficient evidence or retrieval failed)

confidence.description: Confidence score of the verification verdict (0.0 to 1.0)

rationale.description: Detailed justification connecting claim to evidence

evidence.description: List of evidence items retrieved and compared against this claim

needs_human_review.description: Flag indicating that human intervention is necessary

review_reasons.description: Explicit trigger reasons for human review
